title: MQTT Importer Configuration
description: Broker connection, credentials, and inbound subscription settings.

port.title: Broker Port
port.description: Broker port; pair with use_tls for the secure port.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Client id presented to the broker.

use_tls.title: Use TLS
use_tls.description: Connect with TLS using the default SSL context.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Leave empty for an anonymous broker.

username.title: Username
username.description: Set with the password; both empty allows anonymous access.

password.title: Password
password.description: Set with the username. Wire to a secret.

reconnect_interval.title: Reconnect Interval (s)
reconnect_interval.description: Seconds before retrying a dropped connection.

qos.title: Subscribe QoS
qos.description: MQTT quality of service for inbound subscriptions: 0 at-most-once, 1 at-least-once, 2 exactly-once.
